author: Meera Pillai
alert_description: authentication failure rate is 20.3% on auth-svc (threshold 12%)
discriminators: one node's clock is tens of seconds off while the others are within milliseconds
auth-svc rejects tokens as used before issued
only a fraction of auth requests fail (not all of them, as an expired cert would cause)

steps.note: checked node_clock_offset_ms first (INC-4213) and drained the node

migration_context: 14 days after the Redis to Valkey migration (M2, 10 Sep)
